display_fil:
Ben: Lagundi, hirap sa paghinga
Joel: Ampalaya, diabetes medicine
Mara: Bayabas, sugat na may nana
display_en:
Ben: Lagundi, breathing difficulty
Joel: Ampalaya, diabetes medicine
Mara: Bayabas, wound with pus
narration_fil: Tatlong residente ang nagtatanong tungkol sa halaman. Nagtanong si Ben tungkol sa Lagundi at hirap siyang huminga. Nagtanong si Joel tungkol sa Ampalaya at umiinom siya ng diabetes medicine. Nagtanong si Mara tungkol sa Bayabas at may sugat siyang may nana.
narration_en: Three residents ask about plants. Ben asks about Lagundi and has breathing difficulty. Joel asks about Ampalaya and takes diabetes medicine. Mara asks about Bayabas and has a wound with pus.

display_fil:
Itugma ang halaman, botanical name at gamit.
Agad i-refer ang hirap sa paghinga at sugat.
Huwag palitan ang diabetes medicine.
Dry props lamang; walang produkto.
display_en:
Match plant, botanical name and listed use.
Escalate breathing difficulty and the wound.
Keep diabetes medicine unchanged.
Dry props only; no product.
narration_fil: Itugma ang bawat halaman sa botanical name at nakalistang gamit. Agad i-refer ang hirap sa paghinga at ang infected wound. Huwag palitan ang diabetes medicine. Kung may awtorisadong trainer, pagkilala lamang ang ipakita, gamit ang dry props; walang ibibigay na produkto.
narration_en: Match each plant to its botanical name and listed use. Escalate breathing difficulty and the infected wound. Do not replace diabetes medicine. If a trainer authorizes a station, demonstrate identification only, with dry props; dispense no product.

display_fil:
Tatlong residente, tatlong halaman.
Ano ang una mong gagawin?
display_en:
Three residents, three plants.
What do you do first?

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang una mong gagawin para sa tatlong residente?
check.prompt_en: What do you do first for the three residents?

options.fil: Kumpirmahin sa kasalukuyang card ang identity ng bawat halaman.
options.en: Confirm each plant's identity on its current card.

options.fil: Hulaan ang bawat halaman mula lamang sa local name o sa isang larawan.
options.en: Guess each plant from its local name or from a picture.

options.fil: Sabihin sa bawat residente kung gaano karami ang gagamitin.
options.en: Tell each resident how much of the plant to use.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Tama: ang kumpirmadong card ang tamang simula sa tatlong kaso. 2: Maaaring magturo sa maling halaman ang pangalan o larawan. 3: Walang dose sa practice; kulang pa ang clinical at lokal na awtorisasyon.
check.feedback_en: 1: Correct: a verified card is the proper start for all three cases. 2: A name or picture can point to the wrong plant. 3: No dose is given in practice; clinical and local authorization are missing.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

display_fil:
Ben at Mara: i-refer muna.
Joel: walang palit na gamot; sa clinician niya.
Bawat worksheet: kulang ang awtorisasyon.
display_en:
Ben and Mara: escalate first.
Joel: medicine unchanged; ask his clinician.
Each worksheet: authorization missing.
narration_fil: Binasa ng BHW ang bawat kasalukuyang card at pinakinggan ang bawat residente. Inuna niyang i-refer ang hirap sa paghinga ni Ben at ang sugat ni Mara na may nana. Kay Joel, sinabi niyang hindi ipapalit ang Ampalaya sa diabetes medicine. Dinala niya ang tanong ni Joel sa clinician nito. Sa bawat worksheet, minarkahan niyang kulang ang local authorization.
narration_en: The BHW reads each current card and listens to each resident. Ben's breathing difficulty and Mara's wound with pus are escalated first. For Joel, the BHW says Ampalaya does not replace his diabetes medicine and takes his question to his clinician. On each worksheet, the BHW marks local authorization as missing.

display_fil:
Hindi clinical sign-off ang pagdalo sa station.
Walang mainit na tubig, ingestion o dose.
Walang ibibigay na produkto.
display_en:
Station attendance is not clinical sign-off.
No hot water, ingestion or dose.
No product is dispensed.
narration_fil: Ang pagdalo sa station ay hindi clinical sign-off. Walang mainit na tubig, aktuwal na ingestion, dosage o pagbibigay ng halamang gamot sa practice.
narration_en: Attendance at the station is not clinical sign-off. No hot water, ingestion, dose or dispensing occurs in practice.

display_fil:
Na-check na ang cards.
Ano ang ligtas na tugon sa bawat residente?
display_en:
The cards are checked.
What is the safe response for each resident?

check.prompt_fil: Pagkatapos ng card check, ano ang ligtas na tugon?
check.prompt_en: After the card check, what is the safe response?

options.fil: Sabihin kay Joel na puwedeng ipalit ang Ampalaya sa diabetes medicine niya.
options.en: Tell Joel he can use Ampalaya in place of his diabetes medicine.

options.fil: Imungkahi ang Lagundi kay Ben at Bayabas kay Mara bago mag-refer.
options.en: Suggest Lagundi for Ben and Bayabas for Mara before any referral.

options.fil: I-refer agad sina Ben at Mara; dalhin sa clinician ni Joel ang tanong niya.
options.en: Escalate Ben and Mara; take Joel's question to his clinician.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Huwag palitan ang diabetes medicine; hindi awtorisado ang pagpapalit ng gamot. 2: Kailangang i-refer muna ang hirap sa paghinga at infected wound, hindi halaman. 3: Tama: i-refer agad ang agarang senyales; ang clinician ni Joel ang magpapasya sa gamot niya.
check.feedback_en: 1: Do not replace diabetes medicine; changing treatment is not authorized. 2: Breathing difficulty and an infected wound need escalation first, not a plant. 3: Correct: escalate the urgent signs; Joel's clinician decides about his medicine.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

display_fil:
Sa Lunes: ipasuri ang card.
Itala ang kulang na impormasyon.
display_en:
On Monday: review the card.
Record missing information.
narration_fil: Sa Lunes, dalhin ang card sa supervisor. Markahan ang dapat kumpirmahin bago gamitin sa tunay na konsultasyon.
narration_en: On Monday, review the card with a supervisor. Mark what needs confirmation before a real consultation.
